notes.title: Update Notes for Apr 16
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing the Arcade mode update!
Here's a small patch to fix a few things based on player feedback:

ENDLESS ENCORE

Tentacles can now take damage during Ina's fight (not just Ina)
Added invincibility frames when forced to switch character
Fixed a bug where music would stop when forced to switch character
Fixed a bug where time would be deleted at the start of some bosses (King Crimson style)

notes.title: ARCADE MODE UPDATE
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing FLARE NUINUI QUEST!

It's been a while since the last update, this one adds the Arcade mode containing two new challenges:

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45235587/19a08e4004ceb0d4a085c1ec4c04221819e29e07.gif
FANTASY RUSH
Play as Flare against the other Hololive Fantasy members in a fast-paced mini boss rush!
Getting hit won’t knock you out, but it will cost you time. Learn each bosses moves, and watch out for their powerful final attacks!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45235587/e90b77e3fa21cdfab47d9d84a6d96dfcccd7dda7.gif
ENDLESS ENCORE
Play as Flare, Noel, Pekora and Marine in a giant boss rush!
You are outnumbered so you'll need to manage your health carefully. Keep your team alive to earn a high score!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45235587/7d525136559b75522eaacef9f8753424410fb97c.gif

A few tips:

Flare and Noel are invincible when sliding
Noel and Marine can destroy projectiles with their attacks
Pekora's laugh button is useless (...unless?)

That's all for now,
don't hesitate to leave some feedback and good luck!

notes.title: Update Notes For Oct 30
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing FLARE NUINUI QUEST!
It’s been a week since the game launched so here's some improvements and fixes based on player feedback:

General Updates

Charged Attacks: Charged attacks are no longer canceled when taking a hit.
Air Vents: Can now be controlled using the jump button.
Credits: Press A to speed up the credits sequence.
Achievement Count: Total achievements are now displayed in the menu.


Nuinui Quest Updates

Miko Petals: Increased petal damage by +1 per hit.
Character Switch Button: New dedicated button for switching characters (Default: Space on keyboard, Select on controllers). For players who have already played with a controller, you may have to set this manually as select is already in use.
Elevator Intros: Shortened intro sequences for the Casino and Port elevators.


Random Quest Updates

Shop Pop-up: A prompt now appears when obtaining a crystal for the first time.
Crystal Retention: Crystals are no longer halved on death.
Shop Prices Adjusted:
  
  +1 Bomb: 20 → 10
  +1 Damage: 20 → 15
  
Final Boss Intro Skip: The intro is now skipped if you’ve previously faced the final boss and died.


Maiden Quest Updates

Anchor Speed: Increased by +50%.
Port 1: Reduced difficulty.
Final Boss Intro Skip: The intro is now skipped if you’ve previously faced the final boss and died.
Result Screen: Added after clearing a stage.


Fixes

Reflected Homing Projectiles: No longer pass through boss shields.
Demon Lord’s Castle: Several rooms now have ceilings.
Timezone Clock: Disabled when starting the Watame Moto phase.
Gamepad Controls: Settings are now saved properly.
